Florida
Florida Markets
No rent control · No state income tax · FL insurance 44–47% OpEx · Garden style 90s target · Wind mitigation credits on pitched roofs.
⚠ Florida Underwriting Flag: Insurance costs remain elevated after +18% in 2025 (stabilizing in 2026). Budget 9–12% of EGI for insurance and 44–47% total OpEx. Always obtain wind mitigation inspection — pitched roof 90s product qualifies for 15–25% premium reduction. FEMA flood zone assessment required on all FL acquisitions. Property tax 0.8–1.2%.
North Carolina
North Carolina Markets
No rent control (statewide statutory prohibition) · 10-day eviction · Property tax 0.60–0.62% · Standard OpEx 42–43%.
South Carolina
South Carolina Markets
No rent control · Landlord-favorable statutes · Property tax 0.5–0.8% (lowest in study) · Standard OpEx 42–44%.
Texas
Texas Markets
No rent control · 3-day eviction (fastest in nation) · No state income tax · Property tax 2.0–2.1% (CRITICAL: budget 14% of EGI explicitly).
⚠ Texas Property Tax Flag: TX property taxes are 2.0–2.1% of assessed value, reassessed EVERY YEAR. Use 46–47% total OpEx — not the standard 42%. Engage a professional property tax protest service post-closing (saves 15–30% annually).

GRC Execution Strategy
Four pillars to drive NOI growth on 90s Class B garden style acquisitions. Quantified for 100-unit property.
01
Reposition Units
  • → LVP flooring over carpet (+$75–150/unit/month)
  • → Stainless appliances, lighting, fixtures
  • → $8K–$15K/unit renovation budget
  • → Target $100–200/mo premium per unit
  • 100u × $150 × 12 = +$180K NOI/yr
02
Capture Loss-to-Lease
  • → 90s vintage often $100–200 below market
  • → Renewal-based increases 3–5% annually
  • → Move-out → reno → re-lease at market
  • → Close full gap within 18–24 months
  • $150 avg × 100u × 12 = +$180K NOI/yr
03
Reduce OpEx
  • → LED conversion (utilities -20-30%)
  • → Wind mitigation inspection (FL: -15-25% insurance)
  • → Property management fee renegotiation (target 6-7%)
  • → Landscaping/maintenance contract consolidation
  • Target 2–4pp OpEx reduction = +$60K NOI/yr
04
Add Income Streams
  • → RUBS — recover water/trash ($50–80/unit/mo)
  • → Pet fees ($50–75/mo + $300–500 deposit)
  • → Covered parking ($25–50/space/mo)
  • → Storage units ($40–75/unit/mo)
  • Total ancillary target: +$90K NOI/yr
